axes.concept: Pliegues de consulta: directly fold and reopen the tool lists in their original plan bands; catalogue data remains informative and immutable.
axes.layout: One ruled paper with four full-width bands. Desktop bands place identity and price in a 28% left column, full cumulative tools in a two-column right region; phone bands stack identity above a single tool list.
axes.navigation: Four wrapping in-page plan links expand their destination band, scroll it into view and focus its heading. Each plan has an independent disclosure. Retained login/account entry links and contextual back link.
axes.typography: Existing embedded Geist Sans and Geist Mono. Fixed 24px H1, 20px plan names, 22px tabular prices (20px on phones), 14px tools and 12px availability annotations; no new font family.
axes.density: Compact 24px ruled bands inside one 32px-radius paper, 28px desktop and 20px phone inset. Every tool is initially visible; folding removes its list without removing name or monthly price.
axes.components: Existing Pictures masthead and native account disclosure, real shadcn/Base UI Button and Input, real Skeleton, semantic article and tool list. Button disclosures replace any plan acquisition action.
axes.colour: Exact Pictures globals.css palette mapped to kit roles with sibling input-edge alias --texto-tenue. Neutral navigation and checkmarks; accent limited to existing brand, links, focus and retained access form action.
axes.motion: Tactile compressed/settled bands: 480ms translateY/scaleY registration staggered by 65ms, 180ms press feedback, rotating disclosure chevrons and spring-settled tool-list reveal. Profile-aware Motion, quiet/reduced final-state parity and hidden-tab CSS pause.
